note: PAPER ONLY. Squad 12: events in the 300 largest US companies (SQ12-*). newSignals = signals on the last close (buy at the next open, hold 63 sessions). Nothing here is a buy by itself: a rule needs a frozen 5-year verdict that qualifies (data/squad12-lab.json firstRun). Halal = the owner's ZAD mark; "unknown" must be checked before any real buy.

SQ12-EGAPHOLD.name: Big company: earnings gap-up of 3%+ that closes in the upper half of the day

SQ12-EARN52H.name: Big company closes at a new 52-week high on its earnings reaction day

SQ12-REVEPS.name: Big company 10-Q: revenue AND diluted EPS both up 10%+ on the same quarter last year

SQ12-ACCEL2.name: Big company whose revenue growth accelerated two quarters in a row (10-Q / 10-K)

SQ12-RAISECONF.name: Big company raises its guidance (8-K) and the market confirms with a higher close

SQ12-INVDAY.name: Big company investor / analyst day (8-K) followed by a higher close
